clips.title: The story
paras: At the Tower of Althalaxx, demonic rites threaten northern Darkshore. Balthule Shadowstrike directs an Alliance assault on Athrikus Narassin, the ancient sorcerer who commands the cult from the tower’s peak.

In northern Darkshore, the ruined Tower of Althalaxx shelters demonic summoning. Balthule Shadowstrike watches the tower from nearby and sees that the threat must be faced now. Athrikus Narassin dwells at the summit, an ancient night elf warlock who directs the dark rituals beneath the shattered roof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to strike. I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Athrikus Narassin is an ancient and powerful warlock. Perhaps we should wait for Delgren's assistance, but he obviously had much faith in you to send you alone.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With the death of Athrikus, I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their threat.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
